# trading-skills

> Free, open-source (MIT) trading skills for AI agents - Claude Code, claude.ai, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI.
> 20 skills. Works on any market (US, India NSE/BSE, UK, Europe, Asia, ETFs, indices, forex, futures, crypto) and any broker. No API keys needed to
> start: free Yahoo Finance data and a built-in paper-trading broker. Every number is computed by tested,
> zero-dependency Python (standard library only), never estimated by the model. Orders go through a hard
> pre-trade risk gate and a human-confirmed preview before submission.

Install:
- Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add reddygopalkrishna/trading-skills` then `/plugin install trading-skills@trading-skills`
- Any agent (skills.sh): `npx skills add reddygopalkrishna/trading-skills`
- claude.ai: upload the `.skill` files from the GitHub releases page
- Requires Python 3.9+; nothing to pip install

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/reddygopalkrishna/trading-skills/blob/main/README.md): overview, install, costs, safety model
- [Usage guide](https://github.com/reddygopalkrishna/trading-skills/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md): first paper trade, symbols for every market, every command, live-broker setup, troubleshooting, FAQ
- [Changelog](https://github.com/reddygopalkrishna/trading-skills/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

## Skills

- [trading-start](https://github.com/reddygopalkrishna/trading-skills/tree/main/skills/trading-start): routes a trading goal to the right skill; daily brief for scheduled runs
- [trading-setup](https://github.com/reddygopalkrishna/trading-skills/tree/main/skills/trading-setup): account, currency, benchmark, risk limits, data provider, broker login
- [trading-data](https://github.com/reddygopalkrishna/trading-skills/tree/main/skills/trading-data): OHLCV bars and quotes for any symbol, 1-minute to monthly
- [trading-chart](https://github.com/reddygopalkrishna/trading-skills/tree/main/skills/trading-chart): trend stage, RSI, MACD, ADX, ATR, squeeze, Supertrend, support/resistance, multi-timeframe bias
- [trading-patterns](https://github.com/reddygopalkrishna/trading-skills/tree/main/skills/trading-patterns): VCP, breakouts, bull flag, cup and handle, double bottom, inside bar, NR7, pocket pivot
- [trading-market](https://github.com/reddygopalkrishna/trading-skills/tree/main/skills/trading-market): risk-on / choppy / correction / risk-off with suggested exposure
- [trading-scanner](https://github.com/reddygopalkrishna/trading-skills/tree/main/skills/trading-scanner): plain-English screens compiled to a safe rule language; 14 presets
- [trading-plan](https://github.com/reddygopalkrishna/trading-skills/tree/main/skills/trading-plan): entry, stop, targets, reward-to-risk and size
- [trading-size](https://github.com/reddygopalkrishna/trading-skills/tree/main/skills/trading-size): fixed-fractional, futures lots, fractional crypto, Kelly, volatility targeting, risk of ruin
- [trading-risk](https://github.com/reddygopalkrishna/trading-skills/tree/main/skills/trading-risk): hard risk checks; issues the approval trading-broker requires
- [trading-backtest](https://github.com/reddygopalkrishna/trading-skills/tree/main/skills/trading-backtest): portfolio backtests with no look-ahead, costs, stops, out-of-sample split, HTML report
- [trading-odds](https://github.com/reddygopalkrishna/trading-skills/tree/main/skills/trading-odds): probability a target hits before the stop; drawdown and ruin ranges
- [trading-journal](https://github.com/reddygopalkrishna/trading-skills/tree/main/skills/trading-journal): SQLite trade journal with R-multiples, grades and CSV import/export
- [trading-review](https://github.com/reddygopalkrishna/trading-skills/tree/main/skills/trading-review): stats by setup and month plus coaching on common leaks
- [trading-broker](https://github.com/reddygopalkrishna/trading-skills/tree/main/skills/trading-broker): paper (default) or live orders with preview and confirm code, kill switch, audit log
- [trading-news](https://github.com/reddygopalkrishna/trading-skills/tree/main/skills/trading-news): only what is new on your stocks, tagged; Google News for every market, Yahoo and SEC 8-Ks for US
- [trading-earnings](https://github.com/reddygopalkrishna/trading-skills/tree/main/skills/trading-earnings): quarterly revenue, margins and EPS vs a year ago for any listed company; SEC filings for US
- [trading-insiders](https://github.com/reddygopalkrishna/trading-skills/tree/main/skills/trading-insiders): US Congress trades (House PTRs, e.g. Pelosi), SEC Form 4, India NSE bulk/block deals and SEBI insider trades
- [trading-entry](https://github.com/reddygopalkrishna/trading-skills/tree/main/skills/trading-entry): bar-by-bar intraday entry timer, opening-range or level breaks, long or short, any exchange
- [trading-alerts](https://github.com/reddygopalkrishna/trading-skills/tree/main/skills/trading-alerts): price, stop/target, % move, opening bell and before-the-close alerts on each exchange's clock

## Brokers and data

- Data: Yahoo Finance (free, default), your own CSV files, or your broker's feed
- Brokers: built-in paper broker (default); live brokers through adapters behind one interface (optional)
